name: Vini Cosmetics (Fogg)
role: incumbents (PE-controlled; not on the config/companies.yaml roster)
recent_moves: 2021 — KKR acquired 54% for US$625m at a US$1.2bn valuation
read: The mass fragrance and deodorant incumbent, Rs1,200cr FY25 operating revenue, 54% held by KKR since a 2021 deal that valued it at US$1.2bn on a US$625m cheque. It is the only priced reference in this repo for Indian mass BPC control, and the contrast with Minimalist is the point: roughly 8.5x revenue for a fast-growing masstige derma D2C brand versus a valuation built on distribution scale in a mass category. Vini also marks a segment gap — fragrances is otherwise thin in this dataset, and no Korean brand in the corridor registry competes in it, so a fragrance-led entry would be running against an entrenched, well-capitalised local owner with no corridor tailwind behind it.
